summary: Member runs that keep failing are re-observed with exponential backoff (30 s doubling to 1 h) instead of every 30 s or on every Run-loop event. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Only the internal retry spacing changes; no operator step or message changes.

api.reason: Master-side scheduling of existing member observation calls; no route, payload or result changes.

roadmap.reason: Fixes review findings in the current destination acceptance slice.

state.reason: The spacing is kept in memory only. A restart observes each run once and backs off again; the pool run records are unchanged.

verification.method: Deterministic Go tests with an explicit time argument (no clock injection needed) for the doubling, the 1 h cap, reset on a changed answer, and nextPendingPeerBackup honouring the wait.
verification.limits: The Run-loop wiring is not exercised by a Run-level test. Core has no explicit operator retry for a member run, so only an answer change resets the spacing.
